SEED.title: PackWise illustrative seed value
SEED.note: Plausible starting value entered for the prototype. Not a sourced or measured value. Requires expert review or replacement with a test report before it can support a claim.

SIM.title: Simulated supplier / transport / billing data
SIM.note: Clearly simulated commercial data used to demonstrate the workflow. No real supplier, price or partnership is implied.

UNECE-DDP17.title: UNECE Standard DDP-17 concerning the marketing and commercial quality control of cashew kernels (2023 edition)
UNECE-DDP17.publisher: United Nations Economic Commission for Europe
UNECE-DDP17.note: Sets a maximum moisture content for cashew kernels and calls for packaging that protects the produce properly. Does not establish a shelf life for any specific pouch.

CODEX-249.title: Codex Standard for Instant Noodles (CXS 249-2006)
CODEX-249.note: Sets maximum moisture for fried and non-fried instant noodles. Does not set a shelf life for any pack.

SALAME.title: Salame, M. — Requirements for barrier packaging (maximum tolerable O2 gain / water gain by food type), as tabulated in food packaging textbooks
SALAME.publisher: Robertson, G.L. Food Packaging: Principles and Practice (CRC Press)
SALAME.note: Order-of-magnitude oxygen tolerance classes (e.g. nuts & snacks 5–15 ppm). Class-level estimates, not product-specific limits.

LABUZA.title: Moisture-gain shelf-life model for packaged dry foods with a linear sorption isotherm
LABUZA.publisher: Labuza et al.; Robertson, Food Packaging: Principles and Practice, ch. on shelf-life
LABUZA.note: ln[(Me−Mi)/(Me−Mc)] = (k/x)(A/Ws)(p0/b)·t. Valid when the isotherm is approximately linear across the aw range traversed and package permeance is constant.

KADER.title: Kader, A.A. (ed.) Postharvest Technology of Horticultural Crops — recommended controlled/modified atmosphere conditions
KADER.note: Recommended O2/CO2 windows and storage temperatures per commodity. Atmospheres are commodity-, cultivar- and maturity-dependent.

USDA-HB66.title: USDA Agriculture Handbook 66 — The Commercial Storage of Fruits, Vegetables, and Florist and Nursery Stocks
USDA-HB66.note: Respiration rate ranges versus temperature. Ranges are wide; cultivar and maturity matter.

FISHMAN.title: Fishman, S., Rodov, V., Ben-Yehoshua, S. (1996) Mathematical model for perforation effect on oxygen and water vapor dynamics in modified-atmosphere packages
FISHMAN.note: Diffusion through a perforation with an end-correction term (L + r). Used here for per-hole gas conductance.

GUILLARD.title: Guillard, V. et al. (2012) Uncertainty propagation in MAP modelling
GUILLARD.publisher: INRAE/IATE — cited by the TAILORPACK portal
GUILLARD.note: Motivates reporting a probability range instead of a single equilibrium value.

POLYMER-HANDBOOK.title: Typical barrier properties of packaging films (literature ranges compiled in food packaging textbooks and supplier technical literature)
POLYMER-HANDBOOK.publisher: Robertson (2013); Massey, Permeability Properties of Plastics and Elastomers (2003)
POLYMER-HANDBOOK.note: Generic typical values. A specific commercial film must be matched on its own documented test report (test method, temperature, RH, thickness).

ASTM-F88.title: ASTM F88 — Standard Test Method for Seal Strength of Flexible Barrier Materials

ASTM-F2096.title: ASTM F2096 — Detecting Gross Leaks in Packaging by Internal Pressurization (Bubble Test)

ASTM-F1140.title: ASTM F1140 — Internal Pressurization Failure Resistance of Unrestrained Packages (burst)

ASTM-D3985.title: ASTM D3985 — Oxygen Gas Transmission Rate Through Plastic Film Using a Coulometric Sensor

ASTM-F1249.title: ASTM F1249 — Water Vapor Transmission Rate Through Plastic Film Using a Modulated Infrared Sensor

ISTA-1A.title: ISTA 1A — Packaged-Products 150 lb (68 kg) or Less: non-simulation integrity test (drop heights by weight)

MCKEE.title: McKee, Gander & Wachuta (1963) — Compression strength formula for corrugated boxes
MCKEE.note: BCT ≈ 5.87 · ECT · √(caliper · perimeter). Environmental derating factors are commonly cited industry rules of thumb.

ISO-2859.title: Zero-acceptance (c = 0) attribute sampling: n = ln(1 − C) / ln(1 − p)
ISO-2859.publisher: Statistical quality control (cf. ISO 2859-1 / Squeglia c=0 plans)

PWM-2022.title: Plastic Waste Management (Amendment) Rules, 2022 — EPR categories I–IV
PWM-2022.publisher: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India
PWM-2022.note: Category I rigid; II flexible single/multilayer of different plastics; III multilayered plastic with at least one non-plastic layer; IV compostable plastics.

FDA-114.title: 21 CFR Part 114 — Acidified foods (equilibrium pH ≤ 4.6 boundary)
FDA-114.note: Used only as a widely referenced pH boundary indicating when acidity is decision-critical; Indian FSSAI requirements must be checked for the actual product.

GS1-EPCIS.title: GS1 EPCIS 2.0 — supply-chain event standard; GS1 Digital Link
GS1-EPCIS.note: Event design (what/when/where/why) informed by EPCIS concepts. No compliance claim is made.

OSRM.title: OSRM routing (public demo server) on OpenStreetMap data

BUCK.title: Saturation vapour pressure of water (Magnus–Alduchov form)
